title: Residue rank-one kernel gives a one-column residual normal form
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, X and Y finite projective R-modules, f:X->Y an R-linear map, and p a prime. Set A=R_p and kappa=A/m_A. Assume the kernel of f tensor_R kappa is isomorphic to kappa. Then there exist a free A-module C and an A-linear map g:A->C such that ker(g) is linearly equivalent to ker(f tensor_R A), and the localization at p of Y/im(f) is linearly equivalent to C/im(g). No condition is imposed on the kernel over A, and g need not be zero.

source.place: Tags 00O0 and 00NX; the rank-(n-1) unit-minor adaptation of the proof of Lemma 10.79.4, with exact localization and scalar-extension comparisons.

proof.text: Obtain U,C,g,freedom of C and the two conjugating equivalences from residue_kernel_unit_minor_normal_form. This is only the matrix portion of the argument.
Apply the proved residue_kernel_unit_minor_quotient to the extended linear map and its actual diagonal identity. This gives the kernel identification and the cokernel identification over A.
Compose the localized-cokernel comparison with the diagonal-form cokernel equivalence and package C,g,its freeness and both equivalences.

theorem residue_kernel_unit_minor
    (R : Type v) [CommRing R] (X Y : ModuleCat.{v} R) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hfX : Module.Finite R X) (hfY : Module.Finite R Y)
    (hpX : Module.Projective R X) (hpY : Module.Projective R Y)
    (𝔭 : Ideal R) [𝔭.IsPrime]
    (hres : Nonempty (LinearMap.ker ((ModuleCat.extendScalars
      ((IsLocalRing.residue (Localization.AtPrime 𝔭)).comp
        (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime 𝔭)))).map f).hom
      ≃ₗ[IsLocalRing.ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime 𝔭)]
        IsLocalRing.ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime 𝔭))) :
    ∃ (C : ModuleCat.{v} (Localization.AtPrime 𝔭))
      (g : Localization.AtPrime 𝔭 →ₗ[Localization.AtPrime 𝔭] C),
      Module.Free (Localization.AtPrime 𝔭) C ∧
      Nonempty (LinearMap.ker g ≃ₗ[Localization.AtPrime 𝔭]
        LinearMap.ker ((ModuleCat.extendScalars
          (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime 𝔭))).map f).hom) ∧
      Nonempty (LocalizedModule 𝔭.primeCompl (Y ⧸ LinearMap.range f.hom)
        ≃ₗ[Localization.AtPrime 𝔭] (C ⧸ LinearMap.range g))
